title: Analysis Check Verdict
description: ANALYZE-stage check-panel artifact. Shared by fairness-auditor, compliance-auditor, and goal-alignment-checker via the panel_role discriminator (decision H — NOT named panel_verdict). pass is derived from violations: if violations is non-empty then pass MUST be false (allOf structural enforcement).

panel_role.description: Which check-panel agent produced this verdict

pass.description: True iff no violations found — derived from violations, never hand-set

violations.description: Human-readable violation descriptions; empty array means clean

notes.description: Optional free-text notes from the auditor
